_meta.method: Playwright (chromium) navigating both the production build of the implementation (localhost:3000) and the read-only reference export served statically (localhost:4001), at 8 required viewports for real top-level pages and 3 representative viewports for detail pages.
_meta.trustworthyReferenceReason: index.html and programs/little-explorer-program.html are the only two reference pages that ship their full component CSS inline. The other 12 pages depend on Framer's JS runtime lazy-injecting per-component style-preset CSS at runtime (keyed by a data-styles-preset id resolving to a small JS chunk); that mechanism does not complete in this sandboxed headless environment (confirmed: the CSS rule exists locally but never gets injected), so those 12 pages' reference captures show unstyled fallback HTML (e.g. <h1> at the browser-default 24px/sans-serif) rather than the true design. Their `delta` fields are intentionally null to avoid presenting misleading numbers.

elementSelectors.nav: nav, [data-framer-name="Header "], [data-framer-name="Header"], header (first match) — DOM structure genuinely differs between reimplementation and reference, so this does not always identify visually-equivalent elements
elementSelectors.cta: a[href*="admission"], a[href*="contact"], button (first match) — best-effort only
